    // Live view of the model: the model input merged with the current (raw) form value, so

    private readonly regionFilterValue = toSignal(this.form.controls.region.valueChanges, { initialValue: null });
    protected readonly regionFilteredOptions = computed(() => {
        const filterValue = this.regionFilterValue();
        const filterText = typeof filterValue === 'string' ? filterValue.toLowerCase() : '';
        return this.regionOptions().filter(option =>
            option.value === filterValue || String(option.displayName).toLowerCase().includes(filterText));
    });

    protected readonly createAddressesItem = (): FormGroup => {
        const itemGroup = new FormGroup({
            id: new FormControl<string | null>(null),
            city: new FormControl<string | null>('Amsterdam'),
            country: new FormControl('NL'),
            street: new FormControl<string | null>(null),
            houseNumber: new FormControl<string | null>(null),
            verified: new FormControl<boolean>({ value: false, disabled: true }),
        });
        itemGroup.get('verified')?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        return itemGroup;
    };

    private readonly resizeAddressesArray = (length: number): void => {
        const formArray = this.form.get('addresses') as FormArray<FormGroup>;
        while (formArray.length > length) {
            formArray.removeAt(formArray.length - 1, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        while (formArray.length < length) {
            const item = this.createAddressesItem();
            if (formArray.disabled) {
                item.disable({ emitEvent: false });
            }
            formArray.push(item, { emitEvent: false });
        }
    };

    protected readonly addAddressesItem = (): void => {
        this.addressesOriginalRows = [...this.addressesOriginalRows, {}];
        this.form.controls.addresses.push(this.createAddressesItem());
        this.form.markAsDirty();
    };

    protected readonly removeAddressesItem = (index: number): void => {
        this.addressesOriginalRows = this.addressesOriginalRows.filter((_, originalRowIndex) => originalRowIndex !== index);
        this.form.controls.addresses.removeAt(index);
        this.form.markAsDirty();
    };

    constructor() {
        effect(() => {
            const model = this.model();
            this.addressesOriginalRows = [...(model.addresses ?? [])];
            this.resizeAddressesArray(model.addresses?.length ?? 0);
            this.form.patchValue(model as unknown as typeof this.form.value, { emitEvent: false });
        });
        effect(() => {
            const propertyExpressions = this.fieldsPropertyExpressions();
            if (!propertyExpressions) {
                return;
            }
            const model = this.currentModel();
            // setValue emits so currentModel recomputes and dependent (chained) expressions rerun;
            // the equality guard is what terminates that loop (Object.is, so a NaN result is
            // treated as stable instead of looping forever).
            Object.entries(propertyExpressions).forEach(([propertyName, expression]) => {
                const control = this.form.get(propertyName);
                const value = expression(model);
                if (control && !Object.is(control.value, value)) {
                    control.setValue(value);
                }
            });
        });
        effect(() => {
            const model = this.currentModel();
            const requiredExpressions = this.fieldsRequiredExpressions();
            if (!requiredExpressions) {
                return;
            }
            Object.entries(requiredExpressions).forEach(([propertyName, isRequired]) => {
                const control = this.form.get(propertyName);
                if (!control) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isRequired(model)) {
                    control.addValidators(Validators.required);
                } else {
                    control.removeValidators(Validators.required);
                }
                control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
            });
        });
        // Single source of truth for enabled/disabled state: readonly mode, static readonly
        // (including group readonly), disable expressions, and hidden state (a hidden control is
        // disabled so it stops contributing to form validity, mirroring Formly's hidden fields).
        effect(() => {
            const model = this.currentModel();
            const readonly = this.isReadonly();
            const hideExpressions = this.fieldsHideExpressions();
            const disableExpressions = this.fieldsDisableExpressions();
            this.controlStates.forEach(({ key, staticVisible, staticReadonly }) => {
                const control = this.form.get(key);
                if (!control) {
                    return;
                }
                const hidden = !staticVisible || (hideExpressions?.[key]?.(model) ?? false);
                const disabled = readonly || hidden || staticReadonly || (disableExpressions?.[key]?.(model) ?? false);
                if (disabled !== control.disabled) {
                    if (disabled) {
                        control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
                    } else {
                        control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
                    }
                }
            });
            if (!this.form.controls.addresses.disabled) {
                this.form.controls.addresses.controls.forEach((itemGroup, index) => {
                    const rowModel = this.addressesRowModel(index);
                    this.addressesItemControlStates.forEach(({ key, controlName, staticVisible, staticReadonly }) => {
                        const control = itemGroup.get(controlName);
                        if (!control) {
                            return;
                        }
                        const disabled = this.isHidden(key, staticVisible, rowModel) || staticReadonly;
                        if (disabled !== control.disabled) {
                            if (disabled) {
                                control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
                            } else {
                                control.enable({ emitEvent: false });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private lastSubmitTime = 0;

    protected readonly onSubmit = (event: Event): void => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!this.form.valid) {
            this.form.markAllAsTouched();
            return;
        }
        if (Date.now() - this.lastSubmitTime < 500) {
            return;
        }
        this.lastSubmitTime = Date.now();
        const rawValue = this.form.getRawValue();
        const mergedModel = { ...this.model(), ...rawValue, addresses: rawValue.addresses.map((row, index) => ({ ...(this.addressesOriginalRows[index] ?? {}), ...row })) } as IFormMock;
        this.model.set(mergedModel);
        this.save.emit(mergedModel);
    };

    // Array-item children pass the current row as arrayItemModel so their expressions evaluate
    // per row (Formly parity: a nested field's expression received the nested model).
    protected readonly isHidden = (propertyName: string, staticVisible: boolean, arrayItemModel?: unknown): boolean => {
        if (!staticVisible) {
            return true;
        }

        return this.fieldsHideExpressions()?.[propertyName]?.((arrayItemModel ?? this.currentModel()) as IFormMock) ?? false;
    };

    protected readonly isDisabled = (propertyName: string, staticReadonly: boolean, arrayItemModel?: unknown): boolean => {
        return this.isReadonly() || staticReadonly
            || (this.fieldsDisableExpressions()?.[propertyName]?.((arrayItemModel ?? this.currentModel()) as IFormMock) ?? false);
    };

    protected readonly isOptionSelected = (control: AbstractControl | null, value: unknown): boolean =>
        ((control?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? []).includes(value);

    protected readonly toggleOption = (control: AbstractControl | null, value: unknown, checked: boolean): void => {
        const currentValues = (control?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? [];
        control?.setValue(checked ? [...currentValues, value] : currentValues.filter(item => item !== value));
        control?.markAsDirty();
    };

    protected readonly toggleSelectAll = (control: AbstractControl | null, options: { value: unknown; displayName: unknown }[]): void => {
        const values = options.map(option => option.value);
        const selectedValues = ((control?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? []).filter(value => values.includes(value));
        control?.setValue(selectedValues.length === values.length ? [] : values);
        control?.markAsDirty();
    };

    protected readonly readonlyValue = (control: AbstractControl | null): string =>
        String(control?.value ?? '');

    protected readonly readonlyBooleanValue = (control: AbstractControl | null): string =>
        control?.value ? $localize`:@@entry.readonly.boolean.yes:Yes` : $localize`:@@entry.readonly.boolean.no:No`;

    protected readonly selectedDisplayName = (value: unknown, options: { value: unknown; displayName: unknown }[]): string =>
        Array.isArray(value)
            ? value.map(item => options.find(option => option.value === item)?.displayName ?? item).join(', ')
            : String(options.find(option => option.value === value)?.displayName ?? value ?? '');
}
